sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

[UNIT_CONVERSION] I2_034_KiloNewtonQuantityShape and I2_034_LoadCaseShape sh:sparql: The candidate uses qudt:KiloN for the unit value, but the qudt prefix is bound to http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/; the authoritative KiloN unit IRI is http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN. Consequently, valid kilonewton quantities will not satisfy the unit constraint and the comparison query will not retrieve them. Required change: Bind a separate unit prefix to http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/ and replace every unit value occurrence of qudt:KiloN with the canonical unit IRI unit:KiloN, including sh:hasValue and the SPARQL unit filters.

[LOGIC] gen:I2_034_StructuralMemberShape/sh:or[2]/sh:property[2]/sh:sparql: The SPARQL constraint selects a violation when structuralLocation is not nltl:sideStructureLocation, which rejects the intended non-side branch. Consequently, a longitudinal member at sideStructureLocation can pass this branch without a load case, while a longitudinal member at a non-side location cannot pass it. Required change: Invert the filter so this branch rejects sideStructureLocation, for example FILTER (?location = nltl:sideStructureLocation), leaving the side-location branch as the only branch that requires hasStructuralMemberLoadCase. | [OWNERSHIP_PATH] gen:I2_034_LoadCaseShape/nltl:plasticStrength and gen:I2_034_LoadCaseShape/nltl:midspanPlasticCollapseLoad: Both plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad are constrained as properties of each loadCase, but the authoritative vocabulary assigns both quantities to structuralMember. This changes the ownership/path semantics of the member plastic-strength operands. Required change: Constrain plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad on the structural-member node, and update the comparison query to retrieve those member-owned quantities while comparing them with each load case's demand.
